title: QD-Rec: Open-Ended Evolution of Recommendations via Quality-Diversity
abstract: arXiv:2610.23470v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Open-ended search combined with foundation models has produced advances such as faster algorithms, new results on open mathematical problems, and self-improving agents. We extend this paradigm to recommendation for decision-making, focusing on decisions where the set of possible choices is fixed but the reasons for choosing them are not. In high-stakes decisions, e.g., which company to acquire or which customer to target, comparing diverse, well-reasoned options can be more useful than a single ranked list. We formalize open-ended recommendation as building a diverse, high-quality set of recommendations, each an item together with a hypothesis, a natural-language reason why the item fits the needs of a decision maker. We propose QD-Rec, a quality--diversity method that selects items with a contextual bandit and generates hypotheses with a foundation model from earlier ones kept in an archive as stepping stones. translated_title: QD-Rec：基于质量-多样性的推荐开放式演化
translated_abstract: 开放式搜索与基础模型相结合，已催生了诸如更快的算法、开放数学问题的新成果以及自我改进智能体等进展。我们将这一范式扩展到用于决策制定的推荐，重点关注那些备选方案集合固定但选择理由并非固定的决策。在高风险决策中，例如收购哪家公司或瞄准哪些客户，比较多样化且有充分论证的选项可能比单一的排序列表更有用。我们将开放式推荐形式化为构建一个多样化、高质量的推荐集合，其中每个推荐由一个项目和一个假设组成，该假设是用自然语言解释该项目为何适合决策者需求的理由。我们提出QD-Rec，这是一种质量-多样性方法，它使用上下文老虎机来选择项目，并利用基础模型以存档中保留的早期假设为踏脚石来生成新的假设。
tldr: 提出QD-Rec方法，将质量-多样性算法、上下文老虎机与基础模型相结合，为高风险决策生成多样化、高质量且附带自然语言理由的开放式推荐。
en_tdlr: QD-Rec is a quality-diversity method that combines contextual bandits and foundation models to produce diverse, high-quality open-ended recommendations with natural-language rationales for high-stakes decision-making.
